summary: Form: fields stacked, with its actions at the end.
use: Any form. Fields go in fields, buttons in actions. Give a label when the page has more than one form.

action.description: Where it submits. Without one, it submits to the page it's on; don't make one up.

label.description: Names the form, which also makes it a landmark.

enctype.description: Set it when the form has a form/file-field, with method post.
